records.jp: さて始まりました「かっこいい技名選手権」<CR>実況は金城勇希が担当いたします。
records.en_original: Welcome to this weeks edition of Name That Move. I'm your host, Yuki Kinjou, reporting live!
records.en_auxiliary: Welcome to this weeks edition of Name That Move. I'm your host, Yuki Kinjou, reporting live!
records.en: And so begins the "Cool Move Name Championship"!<CR>Your play-by-play announcer is Kinjou Yuki.

records.jp: 解説には前回王者、星崎愛央さんに<CR>来ていただきました。よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: Joining us with live commentary will be the previous champion, Ao Hoshizaki. Thank you for joining us!
records.en_auxiliary: Joining us with live commentary will be the previous champion, Ao Hoshizaki. Thank you for joining us!
records.en: Joining us for commentary is the previous champion,<CR>Hoshizaki Ao-san. Thank you for being here.

records.jp: よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: Thank you for having me.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you for having me.
records.en: Thank you for having me.

records.jp: さてトップバッターは、平原陽桜莉選手です
records.en_original: Up first, we have Hiori Hirahara.
records.en_auxiliary: Up first, we have Hiori Hirahara.
records.en: Our first contestant is Hirahara Hiori.

records.jp: いきまーす！
records.en_original: Here I go!
records.en_auxiliary: Here I go!
records.en: Here I go!

records.jp: スーパーライトニングゲイボルグサンダー！
records.en_original: Super Lightning Gáe Bulg!
records.en_auxiliary: Super Lightning Gáe Bulg!
records.en: Super Lightning Gae Bulg Thunder!

records.jp: ひたすら雷っぽい言葉を並べたこの作品。<CR>いかがでしょう、星崎さん？
records.en_original: Quite the thunderous performance! What do you think, Ms. Hoshizaki?
records.en_auxiliary: Quite the thunderous performance! What do you think, Ms. Hoshizaki?
records.en: This entry simply strings together thunder-sounding words.<CR>What do you think, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: うん、シンプルながら強さを感じる<CR>いい技だと思いますよ
records.en_original: Simple, yet powerful. An impressive technique, indeed.
records.en_auxiliary: Simple, yet powerful. An impressive technique, indeed.
records.en: Yeah. It's simple, but you can feel its power.<CR>I think it's a good move.

records.jp: では次は靭こころ選手です
records.en_original: Next up, we have Kokoro Utsubo.
records.en_auxiliary: Next up, we have Kokoro Utsubo.
records.en: Next is Utsubo Kokoro.

records.jp: い、いきまーす……
records.en_original: H-here goes nothing...
records.en_auxiliary: H-here goes nothing...
records.en: H-here I go...

records.jp: 必殺！　こころあたーっく！
records.en_original: Ultimate Kokoro Attaaaaack!
records.en_auxiliary: Ultimate Kokoro Attaaaaack!
records.en: Finishing Move! Kokoro Attaaack!

records.jp: これは……かわいらしいですね
records.en_original: Well isn't that the cutest thing you've ever seen.
records.en_auxiliary: Well isn't that the cutest thing you've ever seen.
records.en: This is... adorable.

records.jp: ええ、恥じらいもむしろ味と言えるでしょう
records.en_original: Indeed, the bashfulness was a nice touch.
records.en_auxiliary: Indeed, the bashfulness was a nice touch.
records.en: Yes. Her embarrassment only adds to its charm.

records.jp: では次は久野きらら選手
records.en_original: Next up, Kirara Kuno.
records.en_auxiliary: Next up, Kirara Kuno.
records.en: Next is Kuno Kirara.

records.jp: いきまーす
records.en_original: Here it goes!
records.en_auxiliary: Here it goes!
records.en: Here I go.

records.jp: 星は空、花は地
records.en_original: Stars of heaven, flowers of earth...
records.en_auxiliary: Stars of heaven, flowers of earth...
records.en: Stars belong to the sky, flowers to the earth.

records.jp: 我、全てを砕く者
records.en_original: I am the one who shatters all!
records.en_auxiliary: I am the one who shatters all!
records.en: I am the one who shatters all.

records.jp: 星花流奥義　真・天地壊落！
records.en_original: Secret technique! Earth Render!
records.en_auxiliary: Secret technique! Earth Render!
records.en: Starflower Style Secret Art: True Collapse of Heaven and Earth!

records.jp: これは久野選手の真骨頂とも言える、<CR>純和風な仕上がりですね
records.en_original: Ms. Kuno is really giving it all she's got! I think it paid off. How about you, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Ms. Kuno is really giving it all she's got! I think it paid off. How about you, Ao?
records.en: This thoroughly Japanese-style finish<CR>could be called Kuno-san's true specialty.

records.jp: そうですね。さすが今大会優勝候補と言えるでしょう
records.en_original: Indeed. It's easy to see why she's a favorite to win today.
records.en_auxiliary: Indeed. It's easy to see why she's a favorite to win today.
records.en: Indeed. It's easy to see why she's a favorite to win this tournament.

records.jp: 次は金城勇希選手、お願いします
records.en_original: Next up, we have Yuki Kinjou.
records.en_auxiliary: Next up, we have Yuki Kinjou.
records.en: Next is Kinjou Yuki. Please begin.

records.jp: え、あたしもやるの！？
records.en_original: Huh? Me?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Me?!
records.en: Huh? I have to do it too!?

records.jp: ふ、俺にこの技を使わせるなよな……
records.en_original: Heh, I guess I'll have to use my forbidden technique.
records.en_auxiliary: Heh, I guess I'll have to use my forbidden technique.
records.en: Heh... Don't make me use this move...

records.jp: ジ・エンド
records.en_original: The. End.
records.en_auxiliary: The. End.
records.en: The End.

records.jp: ノリノリじゃん
records.en_original: Such enthusiasm!
records.en_auxiliary: Such enthusiasm!
records.en: You got really into that.

records.jp: さて、選手全て出揃いました。<CR>星崎さん、判定をお願いします
records.en_original: Now that all the participants have had a chance to show their techniques, it's time to announce the winner. Ms Hoshizaki, what is your decision?
records.en_auxiliary: Now that all the participants have had a chance to show their techniques, it's time to announce the winner. Ms Hoshizaki, what is your decision?
records.en: All contestants have now presented their entries.<CR>Hoshizaki-san, please give us your decision.

records.jp: 優勝は……
records.en_original: The winner is...
records.en_auxiliary: The winner is...
records.en: The winner is...

records.jp: 金城勇希！
records.en_original: Yuki Kinjou!
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki Kinjou!
records.en: Kinjou Yuki!

records.jp: っしゃあ、オラァ！
records.en_original: Eff yeah!
records.en_auxiliary: Eff yeah!
records.en: Hell yeah!

records.jp: 完全に勝ちにいってたでしょ。<CR>実況者に徹するフリしてたけど
records.en_original: You were planning to win this thing from the start, weren't you?
records.en_auxiliary: You were planning to win this thing from the start, weren't you?
records.en: You were completely aiming to win, were you not?<CR>You only pretended to devote yourself to announcing.

records.jp: いやいや、そんなそんな
records.en_original: I'm sure I have no idea what you're talking about.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure I have no idea what you're talking about.
records.en: No, no. Nothing of the sort.

records.jp: 靭こころ！
records.en_original: Kokoro Utsubo!
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro Utsubo!
records.en: Utsubo Kokoro!

records.jp: え、わたし？
records.en_original: M-me?
records.en_auxiliary: M-me?
records.en: Huh, me?

records.jp: 嬉しいけど……ううん、嬉しい。<CR>何であれ、愛央ちゃんに認めてもらったんだもんね
records.en_original: I'm...really happy. I'm glad that Ao liked my move.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm...really happy. I'm glad that Ao liked my move.
records.en: I am happy, but... No, I am happy.<CR>Whatever the reason, Ao-chan acknowledged me.

records.jp: （そうそう。この大会は冷静になったら負けだから）
records.en_original: (That's right. You can't think about how embarrassed you are with this kind of stuff.)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's right. You can't think about how embarrassed you are with this kind of stuff.)
records.en: (Right. You lose this tournament the moment you come to your senses.)

records.jp: 平原陽桜莉！
records.en_original: Hiori Hirahara!
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori Hirahara!
records.en: Hirahara Hiori!

records.jp: わーい！　やった！
records.en_original: Yay! I did it!
records.en_auxiliary: Yay! I did it!
records.en: Yay! I did it!

records.jp: やっぱシンプルに強い単語並べるのが<CR>一番強いよ
records.en_original: Can't go wrong just picking a bunch of cool-sounding words.
records.en_auxiliary: Can't go wrong just picking a bunch of cool-sounding words.
records.en: In the end, simply lining up strong-sounding words<CR>is the strongest strategy.

records.jp: そうかなー、へへへ。<CR>思いついた言葉並べただけだったんだけど
records.en_original: Hehehe, I just said whatever popped into my mind.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe, I just said whatever popped into my mind.
records.en: You think so? Hehehe.<CR>I only lined up whatever words came to mind.

records.jp: お姉ちゃんに自慢しよっと
records.en_original: I can't wait to tell Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: I can't wait to tell Mio!
records.en: I'm gonna brag to Onee-chan.

records.jp: （果たして美弦さんには伝わるのだろうか）
records.en_original: (I wonder if Mio will get what we're doing...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I wonder if Mio will get what we're doing...)
records.en: (I wonder whether Mio-san will understand what this is about.)

records.jp: 久野きらら！
records.en_original: Kirara Kuno!
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara Kuno!
records.en: Kuno Kirara!

records.jp: ふっ……わかってはいた
records.en_original: Heh... As if there was any other choice.
records.en_auxiliary: Heh... As if there was any other choice.
records.en: Heh... I knew it.

records.jp: やはり長年の経験は伊達じゃない。<CR>今後とも磨き続けていく所存
records.en_original: I have years of experience after all. I'll continue to perfect my craft.
records.en_auxiliary: I have years of experience after all. I'll continue to perfect my craft.
records.en: Years of experience aren't just for show.<CR>I intend to keep honing my craft.

records.jp: （やっぱきららは貫禄が違うなぁ）
records.en_original: (Kirara's really in a league of her own...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Kirara's really in a league of her own...)
records.en: (Kirara really has a different level of presence.)

records.jp: ところで前回優勝者によるセレモニー技はないのか
records.en_original: Shouldn't the previous winner show off their move from last time first?
records.en_auxiliary: Shouldn't the previous winner show off their move from last time first?
records.en: By the way, is there no ceremonial move from the previous champion?

records.jp: ええー？　欲しがりやさんだなぁ
records.en_original: Aww, I guess I'll show you all how it's done.
records.en_auxiliary: Aww, I guess I'll show you all how it's done.
records.en: Ehh? You sure are demanding.

records.jp: いくよ……んんっ。<CR>贖罪（リデンプション）……
records.en_original: Here I go... Hnnggg... Redemption!
records.en_auxiliary: Here I go... Hnnggg... Redemption!
records.en: Here I go... Ahem.<CR>Atonement... Redemption...

records.jp: あ、みなさーん。<CR>そろそろ休憩に……
records.en_original: Okay everyone, let's take a break...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay everyone, let's take a break...
records.en: Oh, everyone!<CR>It's about time for a break...
